catalog.title: Browse our catalog
catalog.description: Start by exploring all our products. You can see photos, descriptions, benefits and prices to pick the ones you like best.

cart.title: Add your products to the cart
cart.description: When you find something you love, just add it to the cart. You can choose one or several products.

delivery.title: Choose how you want to receive your order
delivery.description: Before confirming, choose whether you prefer home delivery or picking up your order at our store.

confirm.title: Confirm your order on WhatsApp
confirm.description: When you're ready, click the WhatsApp button. You'll send us your product list there and we can help you directly.

quote.title: Get your delivery quote (home delivery only)
quote.description: If you want home delivery, we work out the cost based on your location and send you the total to pay.

pickup.title: Get a confirmation if you're picking up your order
pickup.description: If you'd rather pick it up, we confirm the address, opening hours and availability so you can drop by hassle-free.

payment.title: Pay the easy way
payment.description: You can pay in cash or by QR code, whichever suits you best.

receive.title: Receive your products
receive.description: If you chose home delivery, we bring your order wherever you are. If you chose pickup, we'll be waiting at our store with your order ready.

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.description: We are a small business passionate about healthy natural beauty, making products with 100% natural active ingredients. Our team of experienced professionals is committed to our customers, and we are dedicated to making products that respect and care for your skin and the environment.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To produce and sell natural, handmade and eco-friendly cosmetics with organic, cruelty-free ingredients, meeting our customers' needs with healthier and more sustainable beauty products.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To be a benchmark for innovation and quality in handmade natural cosmetics, offering effective solutions that respect health and the environment; to share the brand's values through meaningful experiences and content; and to use digital marketing to reach a wider audience, including an online store with personalized advice.

collect.title: Do we collect personal information?
collect.description: We do not collect personal information from our customers. We do not store names, emails, phone numbers or addresses.

analyzed.title: What information is analyzed?
analyzed.description: We may analyze browsing data anonymously, such as the pages visited and on-site behavior, solely to improve the experience and performance of the website.

protect.title: How do we protect information?
protect.description: Although we do not store personal data, we take technical measures to keep anonymous information secure and make sure your browsing experience is safe.

updates.title: What happens if we update this policy?
updates.description: Any change will be published in this section of the website. We recommend checking it regularly to stay up to date.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.subHeading: “Every product is born with a clear purpose, inspired by dedicated research into the benefits nature offers us.”
